semantics.platform: Runtime/toolchain family, not host OS or instruction set. Specific implementation in runtime.
semantics.execution: Native AOT, native JIT, or interpretation for this measured variant. Several modes may occur across profiles.
semantics.typing: Language type-checking model; dynamic escape hatches or FFI do not redefine its primary model.
semantics.style: Established idiomatic language paradigms. Overlap is intentional; not a claim each benchmark source uses every paradigm.
semantics.memory: Standard memory models of the measured language/runtime, including normal built-in managed types. Foreign libraries and purely optional alternate collectors are excluded. Different strategies may coexist.
semantics.evidence: Missing historical binary or exact flags does not erase known runtime family; confidence limits are recorded separately.

kotlin.label: Kotlin (JVM)

kotlin.memory_policy: G1 explicitly selected; initial heap 64 MiB, maximum heap 8 GiB. The process RSS limit is separately enforced at 10 GiB.
kotlin.execution_scope: JIT identifies the HotSpot execution mode. An individual main or method can remain interpreted during a single process. No warmup or extra main invocation precedes a measured sample.
kotlin.compilation_outside_timer: Kotlin source compilation to the retained JVM class artifacts
kotlin.compilation_inside_timer: HotSpot tiered runtime compilation during each fresh JVM process
kotlin.runtime_evidence_scope: Compiler version and JDK identity are retained toolchain evidence. JVM flags are required in each timed launch; this metadata does not claim an extra diagnostic probe inside every timed process.
